summary: Gauzy Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, furnished a 6-K disclosing that on November 4, 2026 the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted its request to continue listing on the Nasdaq Stock Market, conditioned on demonstrating compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) by December 15, 2026. The appeal followed a September 15, 2026 Staff Determination Letter proposing delisting from the Nasdaq Global Market due to failure to file its FY2025 Form 20-F. No price, stake or advisor terms were stated. The structural clock is the December 15 cure deadline; watch for the overdue annual report, any extension request, or a delisting announcement.
